description: We are a team of 6 passionate engineering students interested in space, technology, coding, and innovation. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to build an engaging and educational Junior Mission Trainer that inspires young minds to explore space science and mission planning. Our team brings skills in programming, UI/UX, creativity, problem-solving, science, and presentation.
summary:
"Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" is an educational space-survival game designed to help students learn about space exploration through an interactive gaming experience. In our game, players take on the role of young astronauts who experience an unexpected spacecraft accident and become stranded on the Moon. They must explore the lunar environment, survive challenging situations, collect resources, and repair their damaged spacecraft to find a way back to Earth.

The game combines adventure, problem-solving, teamwork, and space science education. Players learn about the Moon, astronauts, spacecraft systems, and the challenges of living in space while completing missions. Our main goal is to make space science more interesting, engaging, and accessible to young students through fun and interactive gameplay, inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational 2D space-survival adventure game designed to introduce students to space exploration in an interesting and interactive way.

1. What Does Our Project Do?

Our game takes players on an exciting journey to the Moon. The story follows a young astronaut who experiences an unexpected spacecraft accident and crash-lands on the lunar surface. The spacecraft gets damaged, and the astronaut becomes stranded on the Moon. Players must explore the lunar environment, complete different missions, overcome challenges, and find ways to repair the spacecraft and return safely to Earth.

2. How Does It Work?

Players control an astronaut and explore the 2D Moon environment. Through gameplay, they experience a space adventure while learning about the challenges astronauts may face during lunar exploration. The game focuses on exploration, mission-based activities, survival challenges, and problem-solving.

3. Benefits and Intended Impact

The main purpose of our project is to make space science easier and more enjoyable for students, especially young learners. It encourages curiosity about the Moon, astronauts, spacecraft, and space exploration. It also helps develop logical thinking, creativity, decision-making, and problem-solving skills through interactive gameplay.

4. Tools and Technologies Used

We developed our project using Godot Engine 4.4, a game development platform. We used GDScript for programming game mechanics and player interactions. We also created 2D game environments, astronaut characters, and visual elements to build an engaging lunar adventure.

5. Creativity and Innovation

Our project combines space education with an adventure and survival game. Instead of learning only through textbooks or presentations, students can explore a virtual lunar environment and experience space-related challenges through gameplay. The astronaut storyline makes scientific learning more interactive and entertaining.

6. Factors Considered by Our Team

Our team focused on creating a student-friendly experience with simple gameplay, engaging visuals, and an interesting storyline. We considered educational value, ease of understanding, creativity, and the importance of making space exploration accessible and enjoyable for young learners.

Our Vision: To inspire students to explore the world of space science, develop an interest in technology, and imagine themselves as the next generation of space explorers.
